connector.name: GitHub Inside Claude Code
connector.registryDescription: Normalized GitHub-CLI bridge for Claude Code - 89 ops, 6 families incl. federation sources
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package github-inside-claude-code. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the kirchlive account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: TAVILY_API_KEY
env.description: API key for the Tavily federation source (gh_research_tavily_search / gh_research_tavily_research). Required only if those research ops are invoked.

env.name: BRAVE_API_KEY
env.description: API key for the Brave Search federation source (gh_research_brave_search). Required only if that research op is invoked.
